title: The canonical degree-one Rees element
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $a\in I$. In the polynomial model of the Rees algebra [def-nagata-rees-algebra], define $a^{(1)}=at$ to be the polynomial with coefficient $a$ in degree one and zero in every other degree, regarded as an element of $\mathcal R_A(I)$. It belongs to the degree-one piece of the Rees grading [def-nagata-rees-piece]. This definition also applies to $a=0$, when $a^{(1)}=0$.
